scope: read-only filesystem, no ROS or hardware; no rebuild

patch.condition: threshold > 0.01 m and goal PENDING or ACTIVE
patch.behavior: keeps submitted goal anchor when new frontier centroid is within threshold; default follows original 1 cm comparison
patch.disclosure: modified explore_lite; record effective parameter and do not call pristine upstream

confidence: Receipt records successful compilation and matching binary hash, matching patch/source hash and CMake source path; binary parameter string corroborates patch presence. The receipt does not bind every source/dependency hash to the build, so exact complete source-to-binary identity is not cryptographically proven.

license.source_notice: BSD 3-clause text in explore.cpp and other source headers; retain applicable notices, conditions and disclaimers in source and binary distributions; no endorsement
license.limitation: No standalone LICENSE found in source tree; preserve actual file-level notices and inspect dependencies before distributing compiled binary.

minimal_rebuild: In an isolated build directory, freeze full source tree hashes and patch/parameter, capture compiler, ROS/catkin/dependency versions and exact build commands; configure against this source and build without starting ROS nodes; record resulting binary hash and compare. Rebuild is not guaranteed byte-identical across toolchains; execute only after test scope authorizes.
